messages:
Maya CSM: Quick heads-up — we're planning quota tier tweaks for a handful of mid-market accounts this week (bumping soft limits, adding burst windows). want to align on comms and timing before we reach out.
Arjun CSM: list of affected accounts: Brightline, Nimbus, MapleHealth. Brightline and Nimbus are on dedicated; MapleHealth is hosted. Brightline is sensitive to any latency blips.
Sophie PMO: timeline? do we plan an automated email or account-level outreach? also need enablement docs updated if limits change.
Maya CSM: target: roll config changes Wed 10:00 PT; customer pings Thur morning. thinking: CSM-led ping for Brightline + Nimbus, automated templated email for MapleHealth. open to push if eng needs more buffer.
Jordan SE: FYI, the quota adjustments touch rate-limiter config on the serving plane. engineering note: small risk of transient 429s during rollout while caches warm. will add a graceful ramp in the rollout plan.
Leo Support: currently ~3 support threads referencing 429 spikes for Brightline last week. If we change tiers we should add a short KB note and triage play for support for 48 hrs after the change.
Sophie PMO: suggested customer message draft? short, transparent, next steps, support link, expected impact window.
Maya CSM: draft template (please comment): ```Hi <Customer>,
Weâ€™re adjusting your quota to better match steady-state usage and reduce throttling. Planned change: Wed 10:00 PT. Expected impact: brief background ramp, possible transient 429s for <5m>. If you see anything longer please reply and weâ€™ll escalate. -- Maya (CSM)```
Arjun CSM: add a small personalized usage snippet: "Your 7-day p50 latency: 120ms; errors: 0.3%". that helps customers understand rationale.
Jordan SE: ops note: will configure a canary of 5% traffic to new tier for 15m, then 50% for 30m, then full. will monitor token-level error rate and auto-rollback on >1% error rate for 10m.
ops-bot: Scheduled job: "quota-rollout-canary" set for 1781237200 (Wed 10:00 PT). Notifications: #eng-oncall, #customer-success. Auto-rollback threshold: 1% 429/5m.
Leo Support: I'll prep a quick KB and create a triage checklist: quick repro steps, where to pull logs (runner-id + request-ids), who to ping in eng.
Sophie PMO: who owns the customer outreach thread? Maya to send Brightline + Nimbus; automated template for MapleHealth via comms tool (Arjun to approve).
Maya CSM: I'll send Brightline + Nimbus, include the usage snippet. Arjun can send MapleHealth template. Jordan, please post the canary schedule and any immediate monitoring links so we can paste in the email.
Jordan SE: will share monitoring dashboard link and an alert snippet (copy below) by EOD.
Maya CSM: thanks — action items: 1) Jordan: monitoring links + canary config (by EOD). 2) Leo: KB + triage checklist (by EOD). 3) Arjun: approve MapleHealth template (ASAP). 4) Sophie: update internal enablement doc w/ new limits (before outreach). 5) Maya: send customer pings Thu morning unless blockers.
Arjun CSM: noted. ping me if any wording needs legal/ops review.
Maya CSM: cool. tagging @ops and @eng-oncall in thread once Jordan posts the links. :thumbsup:
_notes: Single-thread Slack export. Messages are in chronological order, prefixed by sender display name. Includes a small code block for the draft message and an ops-bot automated notification line. Timestamps are unix seconds; last_message_ts >= first_message_ts.
